// Swift の見本
import Foundation
import SwiftUI

/// doc コメント
@MainActor
public final class ViewModel<Item: Identifiable & Sendable>: ObservableObject {
    @Published private(set) var items: [Item] = []
    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "sample", qos: .userInitiated)
    static let shared = ViewModel<Row>()

    init(items: [Item] = []) { self.items = items }

    func load(from url: URL) async throws -> Int {
        let (data, response) = try await URLSession.shared.data(from: url)
        guard let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse, (200..<300).contains(http.statusCode) else {
            throw URLError(.badServerResponse)
        }
        return data.count
    }

    deinit { print("deinit \(Self.self)") }
}

enum Shape: CaseIterable, Codable {
    case circle(radius: Double)
    case square(side: Double)
    var area: Double {
        switch self {
        case .circle(let r): return .pi * r * r
        case let .square(s) where s > 0: return s * s
        default: return 0
        }
    }
}

protocol Drawable { func draw() -> String }
extension Int: Drawable { func draw() -> String { "\(self)" } }

struct ContentView: View {
    @State private var count = 0x1F
    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 8) {
            Text("count: \(count)").font(.headline)
            Button("増やす") { count += 1 }
        }
    }
}

let closure: (Int, Int) -> Int = { $0 + $1 }
let multi = """
    multi-line "string"
    """
let regex = /(\d+)-(\w+)/
if #available(macOS 14, *) { print(closure(1, 2), multi, 1.5e-3, 1_000) }
